Regarding 2 I understand that this is to stop one sub flooding voat. Still, we should be able to resubmit links after a certain time limit, maybe 3 days for example.

As I've now given time to people to answer without me poisoning the well I'll do my whining now:

  1. The time limit for posts and comments annoys the shit out of me. Worst part is that not even as a moderator of a sub can I circumvent this so if I need to answer questions etc. that are posted I need to sit there and wait 30 seconds between them. I've got better things to do.

  2. No ability to set approved submitters. This means that there's no way in hell we can host an AMA here like we've done on reddit. As the likelihood of that person having a voat account that isn't brand spanking new is zero to none. And there's no way we can approve them as submitters so that they can freely answer questions without having to sit there and wait. They've already taken time off their day to do this so why do we need to complicate things?

  3. The PM and Modmail function can only be described as absolutely shit. No message tree to see what has been said before. Especially in modmail I have no idea if another moderator has already answered the question. And if I get a PM from someone and they reply back there's no context.

  4. We mods can't re-approve a removed comment or submissions. I don't understand why that is. I mean mistakes happen and there should we an easy way to undo it.

The above are really easy to fix and I don't understand why it's not done as they're basic simple improvements that make a big difference.

No flairs is a bit meh but something we can live without, and only one sticky allowed. Let us have at least two.
